shown_card_text.title: The blue line becomes the horizon
shown_card_text.what: Your blue line glows and opens into a Paris skyline at blue hour, with the line as the horizon. It is one of the six reusable shots you asked for tonight, made from our own graphics.
shown_card_text.why: You asked for six shots we can reuse across every episode.
shown_card_text.question: What should happen to this shot?
shown_card_text.recommendation: Use it as a chapter card.
context: For a moment a vertical blue bar crosses the line before the skyline opens.
The clip is lower resolution than the episodes, so it gets upscaled in the edit.
It comes with generated sound, which stays labelled until you pick the music.

visual_input_policy: The exact first existing still/poster shown on the source card. It is one frame, not full video or audio.
